test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The radii of two cylinders is in the ratio 3 : 4 and their heights is in the ratio 5 : 2. The ratio of their volumes will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Volumes of cylinders (V₁ : V₂) = (r₁ : r₂)² × (h₁ : h₂)

Given: r₁ : r₂ = 3 : 4 and h₁ : h₂ = 5 : 2

V₁ : V₂ = (3)² × 5 : (4)² × 2

V₁ : V₂ = (9 × 5) : (16 × 2) = 45 : 32

**∴ The correct answer is 45 : 32.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Ratio of radii (r₁ : r₂) = 3 : 4

Ratio of heights (h₁ : h₂) = 5 : 2

Formula used: Volume of a Cylinder (V) = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fba492729790b03ec12e5ab044598ff90970d43e8b5b624bf4f0249144057947.png] 

⇒ Let the radii be 3x and 4x, and heights be 5y and 2y.

⇒ Volume of first cylinder (V₁) = π × (3x)² × 5y

⇒ V₁ = π × 9x² × 5y = 45πx²y

⇒ Volume of second cylinder (V₂) = π × (4x)² × 2y

⇒ V₂ = π × 16x² × 2y = 32πx²y

⇒ Ratio V₁ : V₂ = 45πx²y : 32πx²y

⇒ Ratio = 45 : 32

**∴ The correct answer is 45 : 32.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cylinder

The amount of space occupied by a cylinder is given by V = πr²h, where r is the radius and h is the height.

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the curved surface only is CSA = 2πrh.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The sum of the area of the curved surface and the two circular bases is TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Ratio Property for Cylinders

If radii ratio is a:b and heights ratio is c:d, then Volume ratio = (a² × c) : (b² × d) and CSA ratio = (a × c) : (b × d).
